title: LLM Academy
description: Free, self-paced continuing education on working effectively and safely with large language models.

courses.title: Foundations of Executor-Agnostic Workflows
courses.description: Learn to break work into contracts that any human or model can execute in parallel, safely, using Inversion of Control, Dependency Injection, and the Unit of Work pattern.

courses.title: Applied Probability for LLM Verification
courses.description: Statistics for not getting bamboozled by the robot. Build the probabilistic intuition you need to know when to trust an LLM, when to verify, and how hard.

courses.title: Microservices & a Gateway: One Front Door
courses.description: Using a real Blazor + Netlify Functions app as a guide, learn how a single API gateway reduces coupling, how to separate domain logic from deployment wrappers, how routing-by-redirect works, and why AI belongs outside the deterministic compute path.

courses.title: Composing a Dozen APIs: Gateway Aggregation in Agronomy Studio
courses.description: Using Agronomy Studio's Blazor + TypeScript Netlify backend as a worked example, learn how one gateway fans out to many domain microservices, aggregates their results, and stays trustworthy under partial failure.

courses.title: Testable by Design: Dev/Prod Parity and Deterministic Mocks in Agronomy Studio
courses.description: Using Agronomy Studio's Blazor + Netlify Functions backend, learn how limiting external surfaces, splitting domain logic from function wrappers, and stubbing the LLM make a gateway-backed system fast to test and faithful between local dev and production.
